experiment_data.hypothesis: VLA trained model hidden states encode action prediction knowledge (next action a_{t+1}) that untrained VLA and DINO-V2 lack. Gates: G1 R²>0.3, G2 Δ(trained-untrained)>0.15, G3 Δ(trained-DINO)>0.15

metrics.note: LIBERO action autocorrelation very high — copy a_t predicts a_{t+1} at R²=0.975. Action probe R² must be interpreted relative to this ceiling. Key comparison remains trained-vs-untrained Δ, not absolute R².
